meaning.en: Third-person singular simple present indicative form of wick.

sentences.en: Before cotton became the substance of choice for lamp wicks, dried folded Mullein leaves were used for this purpose.

sentences.en: Perhaps most importantly, silk wicks moisture from the body, making it ideal to use any time of year.
